headline: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide to enhance ChatGPT capabilities
tldr: Today's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI infrastructure, research, and applications. OpenAI's acquisition of NextSlide is expected to improve ChatGPT's presentation capabilities. Meanwhile, researchers are working on rebuilding the Transformer architecture and developing more reliable AI agents. Cloudflare has introduced a new behavioral analysis engine to detect sophisticated bots and AI agents.
